x-e-m1-10.title: Write short email asking teacher to change test date
x-e-m1-10.goal: For email with purpose, reader and word limit, decide necessary info, then write English to meet conditions.
x-e-m1-10.material: Tomorrow (Friday) you get English speaking test but family schedule no let you go. You want email English teacher Ms. Han to ask change test date. Requirements: polite teacher email, 25-45 words.
x-e-m1-10.thinking.0: Choose necessary information within word limit
x-e-m1-10.prereq.0: Polite email patterns like Dear..., Could I...?
x-e-m1-10.s.s1.prompt: Choose everything wey must dey in email within 45 words.
x-e-m1-10.s.s1.hint.0: Say email purpose in one sentence, then check one by one whether each information needed for purpose.
x-e-m1-10.s.s1.hint.1: Think what teacher need know to answer.
x-e-m1-10.s.s1.o.a: Write reason you cannot come in one short sentence
x-e-m1-10.s.s1.r.a: Short reason help politeness. Think how much of word limit reason use.
x-e-m1-10.s.s1.o.b: Write which test you cannot take
x-e-m1-10.s.s1.r.b: Teacher need know which test to change schedule for.
x-e-m1-10.s.s1.o.c: Make mood lighter with funny story
x-e-m1-10.s.s1.r.c: Consider email purpose and word limit together.
x-e-m1-10.s.s1.o.d: Politely ask to change to another day
x-e-m1-10.s.s1.r.d: This choice state email purpose clearly.
x-e-m1-10.s.s1.o.e: Suggest two days you can take test
x-e-m1-10.s.s1.r.e: This give teacher alternative to choose right away.
x-e-m1-10.s.s1.o.f: Describe everything you did over weekend
x-e-m1-10.s.s1.r.f: Within word limit, unrelated information may push out useful details.
x-e-m1-10.s.s1.explain: Email purpose na ask to change schedule, so test name, change request and days you available must be included. Short reason useful but optional under word limit.
x-e-m1-10.s.s1.acc.0: One short reason sentence make teacher impression polite. If fit word limit, good to include.
x-e-m1-10.s.s2.prompt: Write email body to Ms. Han in English. Conditions: 25-45 words, polite, identify test, request change, suggest another day. If sender name at end, count am too.
x-e-m1-10.s.s2.hint.0: First write greeting and which test in one sentence.
x-e-m1-10.s.s2.hint.1: Then suggest another day with sentence like Could I take it on ...?, and count words.
x-e-m1-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Test, request to change it and alternative day all included?
